name: eosinabox
description: A WebAuthn wallet for Antelope chains: static files, no server, keys in the phone's secure hardware.

scripts.chain:up: docker rm -f eosinabox-chain 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name eosinabox-chain -p 127.0.0.1:28888:8888 eosinabox-local-chain && until docker exec eosinabox-chain test -f /booted; do sleep 1; done && echo chain ready on http://localhost:28888
scripts.test: npm run -s build && node --test test/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
